name: mtrancore
description: Core translation library for MTran using Bergamot WASM

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/lib/bergamot dist/lib/cld2 && cp -r src/lib/bergamot/* dist/lib/bergamot/ && cp -r src/lib/cld2/* dist/lib/cld2/
scripts.example:node: cd examples/node && npm install && node index.js
scripts.example:web: cd examples/web && bun install && bun run dev

author: xxnuo
